reasoning: Read both sides. AtomVecEllipsoidKokkos_PackCommBonus (ctor at 214-218) and _UnpackCommBonus (275-279) unconditionally do 'const size_t elements = size_forward; buffer_view<DeviceType>(_buf,buf,maxsend,elements);', and buffer_view (src/KOKKOS/kokkos_type.h:1405-1409) creates an unmanaged LayoutRight view with row stride n1, so the row stride is size_forward. pack_comm_bonus_kokkos/unpack_comm_bonus_kokkos (239-240, 299-300) compute 'offset = size_forward - size_forward_bonus; if (vel_flag) offset += size_velocity;'. The vel path is real: atom_vec_kokkos.cpp:1046 'if (bonus_flag) pack_comm_bonus_kokkos(n, list, buf, 1);' and 1175 for unpack, and the matching AtomVecKokkos_PackCommVel ctor (atom_vec_kokkos.cpp:1033-1035) uses 'const size_t elements = atomKK->avecKK->size_forward + atomKK->avecKK->size_velocity;'. For ellipsoid size_forward = 3 + 0 + size_forward_bonus(4) = 7 (src/atom_vec.cpp:2483-2491, src/atom_vec_ellipsoid.cpp:45 and empty fields_comm) and size_velocity = 3 + 3 (fields_comm_vel={angmom}) = 6. So the x/v functor lays the buffer out with stride 13 while the bonus functor uses stride 7 and writes columns 9..12, i.e. flat offset i*7+9 = (i+1)*7+2 instead of i*13+9. No compensating code: AtomVecEllipsoidKokkos does not override pack/unpack_comm_vel_kokkos. Accesses stay inside the allocation (maxsend is computed from the same total), so it is silent corruption, not a crash.
fix: Add a vel_flag (or explicit stride) parameter to AtomVecEllipsoidKokkos_PackCommBonus/_UnpackCommBonus and use 'const size_t elements = size_forward + (vel_flag ? atomKK->avecKK->size_velocity : 0);' (with maxsend divided by the same value), matching AtomVecKokkos_PackCommVel. Pass vel_flag through from pack_comm_bonus_kokkos/unpack_comm_bonus_kokkos, which already have it.

reasoning: Duplicate of F0027; same code read and same conclusion. Bonus forward-comm functors build the unmanaged buffer view with row stride size_forward (217, 278) while the velocity path lays the buffer out with stride size_forward+size_velocity (atom_vec_kokkos.cpp:1033-1035) and the bonus offset already includes size_velocity (240, 300). For ellipsoid that is stride 7 vs 13 with columns 9..12, so quaternions land in the wrong row.
fix: Same as F0027: size the bonus buffer view with size_forward + (vel_flag ? size_velocity : 0).

reasoning: The character is really there: `LC_ALL=C grep -n '[^ -~\t]' src/KOKKOS/atom_vec_ellipsoid_kokkos.cpp` returns exactly one hit, line 726, and `cat -A` shows 'M-bM-^@M-^Y' = U+2019 in '// if atom J has bonus data, reset J's bonus.ilocal to loc I'. This does violate the documented 7-bit ASCII rule. Two parts of the finding are wrong, though. (1) The claimed CI failure does not happen: tools/coding_standard/whitespace.py only reports an encoding problem when the file fails to decode as UTF-8 ('unknown') or decodes as ISO-8859-1 (check_file lines 91-116, check_folder lines 173-178); a UTF-8-encoded U+2019 decodes cleanly and is never flagged, and no other make check-* target or .github/workflows check scans for non-ASCII. (2) It is not the only offender: src/KOKKOS/fix_rigid_small_kokkos.cpp (237, 688, 692), src/KOKKOS/fix_gjf_kokkos.cpp:132 and src/KOKKOS/kokkos.cpp:74 also contain non-ASCII, and ~19 files elsewhere in src/ do too. So this is a low-severity style-rule cleanup, not a build/CI blocker.
fix: Replace the U+2019 at atom_vec_ellipsoid_kokkos.cpp:726 with a plain ASCII apostrophe (J's), and while at it the en-dash/arrow characters in src/KOKKOS/fix_rigid_small_kokkos.cpp:237,688,692 and src/KOKKOS/fix_gjf_kokkos.cpp:132 (-> instead of the arrow).

reasoning: Read both sides. AtomVecEllipsoid::process_args (src/atom_vec_ellipsoid.cpp:1089-1120) accepts 'superellipsoid', sets atom->superellipsoid_flag and atom->radius_flag, raises size_border_bonus/size_restart_bonus_one to 13, appends 'radius' to fields_grow/copy/border/border_vel/exchange/restart/create and calls setup_fields(). Atom::create_avec calls avec->process_args(narg,arg) unconditionally (src/atom.cpp:695), so 'atom_style ellipsoid/kk superellipsoid' reaches it. grep for 'super' in src/KOKKOS/atom_vec_ellipsoid_kokkos.{cpp,h} returns nothing: the KOKKOS class neither overrides process_args nor knows about bonus_super, hard-codes size_exchange_bonus = 8 in the ctor (line 39), and its bonus pack/unpack functors move exactly shape[3]+quat[4]. fix: Add an AtomVecEllipsoidKokkos::process_args override that calls error->all(FLERR,"Atom style ellipsoid/kk does not support the 'superellipsoid' option") for that argument (and otherwise forwards to AtomVecEllipsoid::process_args), until the 13-wide bonus_super layout and k_radius growth are implemented.
